summary: 봄과 가을에 한반도를 지나가는 흔하지 않은 나그네새로, 꺅도요 무리에 섞여 주로 논에서 보인다. 지렁이와 곤충을 주로 먹는다. 습지나 풀밭 땅 위에 마른 풀잎을 깐 접시 모양 둥지를 짓고 알 4개를 낳는다. 러시아 북부에서 번식하고 동남아시아, 인도, 파키스탄 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

young: 어른새와 거의 같으나 날개덮깃 가장자리가 담황색이고, 등과 어깨깃의 깃 가장자리가 더 가늘다.

similar.how: 꺅도요는 날 때 둘째날개깃 뒤 가장자리에 흰 띠가 뚜렷하고, 꼬리와 부리가 상대적으로 더 길다.
생김새가 거의 같아 펼친 꼬리에서 바깥꼬리깃이 바늘처럼 가는지(바늘꼬리도요) 차츰 넓어지는지(꺅도요사촌)를 보아야 확실히 가려진다.

art.subject: Pin-tailed Snipe (Gallinago stenura), adult, as seen in Korean rice fields on migration in April–May and August–October: head with a buff central crown stripe between blackish lateral crown stripes, a broad buff supercilium that is wider than the dark eye-stripe at the base of the bill, and a dark cheek bar; upperparts mottled blackish-brown and rufous-buff, with narrow pale buff lines along the mantle and scapulars; wing coverts closely barred buff and dark, looking paler than the back. Neck and breast buff, spotted and streaked dark brown; flanks barred; belly white. Bill straight, olive-brown, paler and yellowish towards the base and dark towards the tip; eye dark, set high on the head; legs dull greenish-yellow.
art.pose: standing in a wet rice field, side view
art.scene: Korean rice paddies during spring or autumn migration; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing in a wet paddy: buff-and-blackish striped head with broad buff supercilium at the bill base, cryptic blackish and buff upperparts with narrow pale back lines, paler barred wing coverts, long straight bill, very short tail, greenish-yellow legs
adult, in flight seen from above: dark upperwing with a paler barred covert panel, no clear white trailing edge to the secondaries, toes projecting beyond the short tail
adult, tail spread seen from above: rufous central tail feathers with a dark subterminal band, and on each side several pairs of very narrow, stiff, pin-like outer feathers
art.build: Medium-sized snipe, a little smaller than a Feral Pigeon, stocky and short-necked. Bill straight and long, clearly longer than the head but relatively shorter than a Common Snipe's. Legs short, greenish-yellow. Tail very short, barely projecting beyond the tertials, which cover the primary tips at rest. In flight looks dark-winged, without a clear white trailing edge to the secondaries, and the toes project beyond the tail tip; the spread tail shows several pairs of very narrow, stiff, pin-like outer feathers. Crouches and freezes in wet grass; flushes with a short zig-zag.
avoid: Do not paint a bold white trailing edge to the secondaries in flight — that is Common Snipe (Gallinago gallinago).
Do not paint a bill twice the head length or longer; it is relatively short for a snipe.
Do not paint a tail projecting well beyond the folded wings.
Do not paint long legs or a plain, unpatterned back.
